content: Bafwa mu masumu, kaasi ba moya mu Yesu Kidisitu
Biki tufwani twazonza? Twanangaka kaka muna disumu, ndangu khenda zavula?
Bwalendakanaku! Betu twafwa kedi mu kikuma kya disumu, khi phila twazíngilamwa hika?
Luzimbakani ni betu boosu bana twábonga mbotika mu kukala yi Kidisitu Yesu, mbotika ya lufwa lwandi twábonga?

Disongidila ni, muna mbotika meni yayina ya mu lufwa, bátuzika hakimosi yi yandi ndangu, bwosu buna káfutumuka Kidisitu ha kati dya bafwa, muna khembu ya Tata, bwabuna betu phi twadyatila mu phila yapha ya luzingu.
Kikuma, honi twakala bakangama lutu lumosi mwena yandi muna lufwa luna lwafwanana yi luna lwa yandi, yibwabuna twakála betu phi muna lufutumuku lumosi lwafwanana yi luna lwa yandi.
Twazaya bwabu ni kimutu kyetu kya khulu bákhokakya ha kitakani hakimosi yi Kidisitu, ndangu lutu lwetu lwa masumu lwazimuka amana tukalaku hika bahika ba masumu;
mukuma mutu wuna wáfwa kenina wálubuka mu disumu.
Kinga honi twáfwa hakimosi yi Kidisitu, tukwikidini ni twazínga phi hakimosi yi yandi.
Bwosu tuzayi ni Kidisitu wáfutumuka ku bafwa, kafwaku hika; mukuma lufwa lweku hika yi kiyeka kwena yandi.
Kikuma, ho káfwa, kikuma kya masumu káfwila, mbala mosi kyamakulu, amana ho kisi zinga, kikuma kya Nzambi kisi zingila.
Yihana ni benu-benu phi dibongenu hanga batu bafwa mu mambu matadidini disumu, amana hanga batu ba moya kwena Nzambi, mwena Kidisitu Yesu.
Yihana ni disumu diyalaku muna lutu lwenu lwalu lwisi fwa: lulemvukaku ku tsatu zandi.

Lulambulaku keti kitini kimosi kya lutu lwenu ku tsalulu ya disumu hanga binwaninu bya kukonda masonga. Kaasi dilambulenu benu-benu mu kisalu kya Nzambi, hanga batu benina mu luzingu bafutumukini ku bafwa, amana syenu lutu lwenu lwosu mu kisalu kya Nzambi hanga binwaninu bya kusadila mambu ma masonga.
Kikuma, disumu dyalúyalaku, mukuma benu lweku hika mu luyalu lwa mitsiku kaasi mu luyalu lwa khenda.
Mu kisalu kya masonga
Biki si? Keti twasumukaka kikuma kya buna thweku mu luyalu lwa mitsiku, kaasi mu luyalu lwa khenda? Bwalendakanaku!

Luzayibwoku ni ho lwadihanaka kwena mutu hanga bahika, mu kumulemvukilaka, lwekina bahika ba wuna lwisi lemvukila, holo dya disumu dina disi nata ku lufwa, holo dya bulemvu buna bwisi nata ku masonga?
Kaasi, matondu kwena Nzambi, kunima dya kukala bahika ba disumu, lwálemvuka yi mbundu yosu, ku mbandu ya malongi mana lwakala tambula.
Bwosu lukatukini ku kihika kya disumu, lwekina bahika ba masonga.

Mu nzonzidi ya kimutu mbati zonzila, kikuma kya kulembwa kwa musuni wenu: kikuma phila mosi, bwosu lwátambika lutu lwenu lwosu hanga bahika, mu mambu ma mvindu yi mu mbi mu kutsukina ku mbi, yibwabuna lwalámbula, buthwena, lutu lwenu lwosu hanga bahika, kikuma kya masonga, ndangu lwalenga tsukina ku thumbama.
Mukuma ha lwákala bahika ba disumu, lwákala mu kiphwanza ku mambu matadidini masonga.
Amana khi kibundu lubati buta kwenu? Bima byabi bisi luheka tsoni buthwena, mukuma tsuka ya byawu, lufwa!
Kaasi buthwena, bwosu lukatukini mu kihika kya disumu amana lukituki bahika ba Nzambi, kibundu lwenina kyawu, thumbama, amana ku tsuka, luzingu lwa mvula yi mvula.
Mukuma lufutu lwa disumu lwenina lufwa; kaasi kabu dya khenda dya Nzambi dyenina luzingu lwa mvula yi mvula mwena Kidisitu Yesu, Pfumu wetu.
